title: Antilipschitz on an open neighbourhood gives the derivative lower bound c|s| ≤ |DΦ(w)s|
statement: Let Q, n ∈ ℕ, Φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ^Q, Ω ⊆ ℝⁿ open, c ∈ ℝ and w ∈ Ω. Assume Φ is differentiable at w and c|v − v′| ≤ |Φ(v) − Φ(v′)| for all v, v′ ∈ Ω. Then c|s| ≤ |DΦ(w)s| for every s ∈ ℝⁿ, where DΦ(w) = fderiv ℝ Φ w and |·| is the Euclidean norm. (No sign condition on c is needed.)
lean_statement: ∀ (Q n : ℕ) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl Q) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)) (c : ℝ) (w : Eucl n), IsOpen Ω → w ∈ Ω → DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ w → (∀ v ∈ Ω, ∀ v' ∈ Ω, c * ‖v - v'‖ ≤ ‖Φ v - Φ v'‖) → ∀ s : Eucl n, c * ‖s‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ Φ w s‖
